_comment: Papers managed on Zenodo. concept: the concept record id (its DOI resolves to the latest version). files: Zenodo file name -> repository path. A new version copies the latest version's metadata (title, description, keywords, license, resource type) and sets the fields under 'version'. Use scripts/zenodo.py.

version.notes: Version 2: corrected statements and an errata appendix; every result stated is mechanized axiom-free in the Coq development at https://github.com/blackwell-systems/normalization-confluence (see its CHANGELOG).
